rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
SET @pop:=(SELECT pop FROM k_hpv_dna  WHERE prov_code =@prov_c AND b_year=(@b_year+543)  LIMIT 1);
SET @hprov:=(SELECT hoscode FROM chospital WHERE provcode =@prov_c AND hostype=1 LIMIT 1);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_hpv_dna(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	
  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hpv_test int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hpv_result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hpv_result2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  lbc_test int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  lbc_result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  colpo_test1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  colpo_test2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  colpo_test3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_hpv_dna WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_hpv_dna
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,@pop as target ,hpv_test,hpv_result1,hpv_result2,lbc_test,lbc_result,colpo_test1,colpo_test2,colpo_test3
FROM chospital h LEFT JOIN
(SELECT 
@hprov as hospcode
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(hpv_test IN(1),t.cid,NULL)) as hpv_test
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(hpv_test IN(1) AND hpv_result IN(1),t.cid,NULL)) as hpv_result1
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(hpv_test IN(1) AND hpv_result IN(2),t.cid,NULL)) as hpv_result2

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(lbc_test IN(1) ,t.cid,NULL)) as lbc_test
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(lbc_test IN(1) AND lbc_result BETWEEN 200 AND 308 ,t.cid,NULL)) as lbc_result

,COUNT(DISTINCT if(colpo_result IN('6719') ,t.cid,NULL)) as colpo_test1
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(colpo_result IN('6711','6712') ,t.cid,NULL)) as colpo_test2
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(colpo_result IN('6732') ,t.cid,NULL)) as colpo_test3

FROM  chospital h INNER JOIN  tmp_hpv_dna t  ON h.hoscode=t.hpv_hospcode
WHERE   hpv_date BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND  h.provcode in(@prov_c)
GROUP BY hospcode) a ON h.hoscode=a.hospcode
WHERE h.hostype IN(1) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
);

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM(target) as target ,SUM(hpv_test) as hpv_test ,SUM(hpv_result1) as hpv_result1 ,SUM(hpv_result2) as hpv_result2 ,SUM(lbc_test) as lbc_test ,SUM(lbc_result) as lbc_result ,SUM(colpo_test1) as colpo_test1 ,SUM(colpo_test2) as colpo_test2 ,SUM(colpo_test3) as colpo_test3 ,SUM(colpo_test1+colpo_test2+colpo_test3) as colpo_test  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name FROM ccaatt GROUP BY chw_code,changwatname,zone_code,zone_name) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.chw_code=left(s.areacode,2) AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
